title: Hell House LLC III: Lake of Fire
description: A host takes his show into an abandoned hotel that is rumored to be haunted.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E08 — Storm Front
Harry must delve into the world of dark magic to solve the murders of a local gangster and his girlfriend.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E09 — The Other Dick
After the murder of a private investigator, Harry and the man's assistant try to uncover the truth.

title: Uninvited
description: Spring-break teens and an escaped laboratory mutant cat board a yacht with a financier and his henchmen.

title: Open Grave
description: A man awakes-- without memory -- in a pit full of bodies and must figure out if the people who rescued him are the killers, or if he is the murderer.

title: Demonic Toys
description: Two gunrunners and a pregnant policewoman (Tracy Scoggins) are trapped in a warehouse with a bad boy's toys.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: The Nest
description: A scientist, a sheriff, an exterminator and an island mayor's daughter go on the hunt for mutant meat-eating cockroaches that are terrorizing a peaceful New England fishing village.

title: Mortuary
description: A girl (Mary McDonough) and her boyfriend (David Wallace) suspect her mother (Lynda Day George) and an undertaker are embalming people too soon.

title: Prom Night 4 - Deliver Us from Evil
description: Two teenage couples have a terrible time with a killer monk who has escaped from his cell.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E04 — Sounds Like
A man whose job is to monitor his company's telephone conversations finds his sense of hearing becoming more intense.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E02 — Family
A young couple's dream home comes complete with a neighbor who seems normal but hides a very dark secret.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E01 — Billabong
In the Australian Outback, an American family's vacation takes a nightmarish turn when they meet a local man named Mick Taylor.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E02 — Kutyukutyu
Haunted by the massacre of her parents and brother, Eve sets out on a quest for revenge; in Kutyukutyu, Eve runs afoul of the local police and lands in a jail cell; Mick Taylor finds out that an American teenager is looking for him.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E03 — Salt Lake
Realizing Eve is hunting him, Mick Taylor begins playing a murderous game of cat and mouse.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E04 — Opalville
As Mick's murder spree continues, Eve investigates the cold case disappearance of a young girl, Holly Welles, in the mining town of Opalville.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E05 — Rome
Taking a job as a waitress at a bar, Eve lies in wait for Mick Taylor.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E06 — Wolf Creek
Lured to Wolf Creek Crater, Eve comes face to face with her adversary.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E01 — Journey
A group of tourists sets out on an outback adventure tour, but the driver is killed.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E02 — Outback
Mick gives the tourists water that he has drugged, and they wake up a day later in the middle of the outback with the bus' battery and phone gone.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E03 — Chase
The group struggles with the traumatic turn of events as they realize they are being targeted by Mick, and make their way toward a hill in search of water and civilization.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E04 — Singing
Steve is rescued by two Indigenous stockmen, only to learn they are all being hunted by Mick; the group struggles after Nina is bitten by a snake.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E05 — Shelter
Reaching the compound, Rebecca, Brian, Oskar and Nina meet its oddball caretaker Spence and his family; Nina's mental and physical health continues to deteriorate; Mick interrogates Kelly in his lair.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E06 — Return
Rebecca and Brian navigate their way to Mick's lair; Rebecca goes in search of Danny and manages to find him and Kelly hurt, but still alive; arriving at the lair with an almost catatonic Nina, Mick gets ready for a fight.

description: Ghoulish stories revolve around a remote control, a strange radio, a murderous call-girl, an engagement and a ghost.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: Day of the Dead 2: Contagium
description: In 1968, the military levels a facility after a lethal bacterium is released. In present day, a patient on an outing from a mental institution finds an old vacuum tube, which -- when it is opened -- releases bacteria turning people into zombies.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E10 — What About Bob
Harry's latest lover sneaks out of his place with Bob's skull and delivers it to Dresden's uncle.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E11 — Things That Go Bump
Ancient Mai and Morgan seek refuge at Dresden's place and find themselves trapped by a powerful spell.

title: Fright
description: An English babysitter is terrorized by her friend's ex-husband, escaped from an asylum.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E01 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 1
Heather offers Dave a helping hand, but she may never see that hand again.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E02 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 2
Obsessed with her beauty, Heather insists on an arm replacement made of gold, but it comes at a cost.
